verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉਂ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਆਰਸੀ ਸਭਾ ਸੁਧ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ਦੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: jiau(n) kar niramal aarasee sabhaa sudh sabh koiee dhekhai|

en.bdb: In the clean mirror everybody sees his correct shape.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਾ ਗੋਰੇ ਦਿਸਦਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਕਾਲੇ ਵੰਨੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: goraa gore dhisadhaa kaalaa kaale va(n)n visekhai|

en.bdb: Fair complexion is reflected fair and black one specifically black in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਸਤ ਮੁਖ ਰੋਂਦਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: has has dhekhai hasat mukh ro(n)dhaa rovanahaar sulekhai|

en.bdb: A laughing person finds his face laughing and weeping one as weeping in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਰਸੀ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: lep na lagai aarasee chhia dharasan dhisan bahu bhekhai|

en.bdb: The followers of six philosophies wearing different guises see in it, but the mirror remains detached to them all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਕਰੋਧ ਕੁਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau hai vair virodh karodh kulekhai|

en.bdb: Sense of duality is the evil intellect which is the another name of enmity, opposition and anger.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਸਮਦਰਸ ਸਰੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat niramal niramalaa samadharasee samadharas sarekhai|

en.bdb: Pious followers of the wisdom of Guru always remain pure and egalitarian.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਹੁਇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: bhalaa buraa hui roop na rekhai ||6||

en.bdb: Otherwise, there is no other distinction of the good and the bad person.
